annotations.title: Find students whose workout is due for renewal

description: Active students who keep training (finished a workout in the last 30 days) but whose workouts and programs have not changed for longer than the trainer's "renew the workout" reminder (Preferences, 6 weeks by default), with name, phone (the guardian's for a dependent), date of the last change, days_on_same_workout, workouts_url (the student's workouts screen, where the trainer renews it) and app_url of the profile, oldest first. Use it to answer "whose workout is overdue?" and then get_student or list_student_programs for one of them. Students who stopped training are list_inactive_students. Read only: nothing changes and nothing is sent.

weeks.description: Weeks on the same workout, 1 to 12, for this question only. Default: the trainer's Preferences.

name: list_workouts_to_renew
